content.short: AGNI Finance is a high-performance decentralized exchange and launchpad built on the Mantle Network.
content.description: AGNI Finance is a leading automated market maker (AMM) and decentralized exchange (DEX) natively built on the Mantle Network. It utilizes a concentrated liquidity model to provide traders with superior swap rates and liquidity providers with higher capital efficiency compared to traditional AMMs. Beyond its trading capabilities, AGNI serves as a comprehensive growth hub, featuring a permissionless launchpad for new projects entering the Mantle ecosystem. By integrating deeply with Mantle's modular architecture, AGNI offers fast transaction speeds and minimal fees, making it a cornerstone protocol for users seeking to participate in the burgeoning DeFi landscape on the Mantle Layer 2.
content.meta: AGNI Finance is the central DEX and launchpad on Mantle Network, offering concentrated liquidity and high-efficiency trading for Web3 users.
